{{For|[[Challenge Trials]]}}
'''Challenge Maps'''
---- {{RemovedSandboxOnly|date = 24th of September 2025}}
''For quests, see [[Quests]], while for mission quests, see [[Mission Quests]].'' '''Challenge Maps''' were regular maps with modifiers applied to them, which increased their difficulty. It could be found in the ''Quests'' menu under the ''Challenges'' tab. Upon triumphing the map, players were rewarded with various rewards. This feature has been removed from the main game and can currently only be accessed through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode.
__TOC__ ==Mechanics== [[File:ChallengeMaps.png|thumb|200px]] '''Challenge Maps''' did not require anything to be activated, other than having a level requirement of {{Level|50}}. Rewards from a '''Challenge Map''' could only be claimed once each week. Losing granted no rewards other than {{Exp|0}}. Triumphing granted rewards that changed based on the challenge. One '''Challenge Map''' appeared every week, resetting at 00:00 UTC on Sundays. The challenge was the same for each player. ==Last Challenge== {{ChallengeBox |Challenge = Juggernaut |Icon1 = NukeIcon.png |Reward1 = 2 |Icon2 = GemPile.png |Reward2 = 137 |Icon3 = TimeScaleTickets.png |Reward3 = 4 |Icon4 = Exp.png |Reward4 = 440 |MapIcon = MasonArchIcon.png }} ==Challenges== {{Challenge |name = [[Back to Basics (Challenge)|Back to Basics]] |map = [[Dusty Bridges]] |mode = [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] |changes = Every player has the [[Scout]], [[Sniper]], [[Demoman]], [[Soldier]] and [[Hunter]] in their loadout. Wave structure is made harder, some enemy stats are altered, starting cash is set to {{Money|700}} ({{Money|800}} if in the Paradoxum Games group) and towers are intended to give back their total cost when sold. Detailed change list can be found [[Back to Basics (Challenge)#Changes|here]]. |rewards = {{TimeScaleTicket|3}}, {{Gem|125}}, {{Exp|400}} and three [[High Grade Crate]]s }} {{Challenge |name = [[Jailed Towers (Challenge)|Jailed Towers]] |map = [[Rocket Arena]] |mode = [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] |changes = After Wave 5, one type of tower will be locked per player each wave. Additionally, wave structure is updated to spawn more enemies and give them attributes, making it more challenging. Detailed change list can be found [[Jailed Towers (Challenge)#Changes|here]]. |rewards = {{Gem|100}}, {{TimeScaleTicket|2}}, {{Exp|200}} and two [[High Grade Crate]]s }} {{Challenge |name = [[Juggernaut (Challenge)|Juggernaut]] |map = [[Mason Arch]] |mode = [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] |changes = Enemies have their defense increased by 50% and are all given the [[Bloated]] attribute, while some of them have the [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] attribute. Starting cash is set to {{Money|800}} ({{Money|900}} if in the Paradoxum Games group) and wave bonus is boosted heavily. Detailed change list can be found [[Juggernaut (Challenge)#Changes|here]]. |rewards = {{Gem|137}}, {{TimeScaleTicket|4}}, {{Exp|440}} and two [[Nuke]]sBase rewards are {{Gem|125}}, {{TimeScaleTicket|4}}, {{Exp|400}} and two [[Nuke]]s. }} {{Challenge |name = [[Legion (Challenge)|Legion]] |map = [[Infernal Abyss]] |mode = [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] |changes = Most enemies spawn twice, waves are altered to have stronger enemies and wave bonus is reduced. However, they were not intended to appear as a proper '''Challenge Map''' which appeared in the '''Challenge Map''' rotation. These were all the map which use the '''Challenge Map''' system, but were not actually '''Challenge Maps''' as they could not appear as one of the '''Challenge Maps''' every week. *''Badlands II'' - [[Badlands II]] *''Portal to the Past'' - [[Classic Candy Cane Lane]] *''Return of the Korblox'' - [[Classic Winter]] *''Clash at the Forest Camp'' - [[Classic Forest Camp]] *''Tropical Turmoil'' - [[Classic Island Chaos]] *''Castle Siege'' - [[Classic Castle]] *''Pizza Party'' - [[Pizza Party]] *''Polluted Wasteland II'' - [[Polluted Wasteland II]] ==Challenge History== If a challenge started in one month but ended in another, it will be listed in the month that it started in.
